correctness.rationale: For real ℓ1^n→ℓ∞^m maps the induced norm is the maximum entry magnitude, so unit ball is [-1,1]^{mn} and extremes are exactly sign matrices. Every norm-one rank-one A=uvᵀ has a finite decomposition into rank-one sign matrices using independent Bernoulli signs with expectations u_i and v_j. For each r≥2, choose S with columns 1 and 1−2e_1,...,1−2e_{r−2} and S′ obtained by flipping row r−1, column r. Then ranks are r−1,r, every strict interior edge point has rank r, and every saturated coordinate forces any extreme decomposition to use both S and S′, hence a lower-rank vertex. All m,n≥r covered, including r=2, one-row/column cases have only rank1. Inspected exact-rational checker for ranks and independent-sign barycentres; finite tests are supplemental, not a universal argument.
